status: RESEARCH PIN: window hashes of canonical daily values and a hash of the derived monthly values only; no raw third-party data; rights UNVERIFIED; the method is conditionally accepted for research only; a hash is not an archive of the original bytes

acquisition_reference.provider: Coin Metrics Community API v4, asset btc, metric PriceUSD, frequency 1d

window_rule: sha256 over 'day:value' lines (canonical decimals) for first <= day <= last; observations after 'last' do not change the pin, a revision inside the window does. The ECB window equals the BTC-03 and HIST-10 pin.
